events.name: New York Yankees at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Jake Bennett held New York to one run in 6 1/3 innings, Masataka Yoshida hit a leadoff home run off Gerrit Cole and the Boston Red Sox beat the Yankees for the third straight day, 4-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Bennett's strong start, Masataka Yoshida's HR off Gerrit Cole carry Red Sox past Yankees 4-1

headlines.description: — Isaac Paredes hit a two-run double in the eighth inning and the Houston Astros spoiled their former manager's opportunity at a milestone victory by rallying for an 8-6 win over the Detroit Tigers on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Astros rally for 8-6 win over Tigers, keeping AJ Hinch at 999 career victories

events.name: Texas Rangers at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Corey Seager hit a solo home run, Jake Burger had three hits and drove in two runs and the Texas Rangers beat the Toronto Blue Jays 7-4 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seager hits solo HR, Burger has 3 hits and 2 RBIs as Rangers beat Blue Jays 7-4

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Francisco Lindor and Juan Soto each hit a pivotal triple as the New York Mets defeated the Philadelphia Phillies 6-2 on Saturday to stop their seven-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Triples by Lindor and Soto lead Mets past Phillies 6-2 to snap 7-game skid and give Green 1st win

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Jacob Gonzalez hit a one-out RBI single in the ninth inning to give the Chicago White Sox a 2-1 walk-off win over the Kansas City Royals on Saturday, and 10 consecutive home series victories for the first time in franchise history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gonzalez hits RBI single in ninth as White Sox beat Royals 2-1

headlines.description: — Eugenio Suárez hit a three-run homer with two outs in the ninth inning that rallied the Cincinnati Reds to a 9-7 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eugenio Suárez hits 3-run homer in 9th as Reds rally for 9-7 win over Pirates

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero homered for the third consecutive game, Jonathan Aranda added a two-run home run and the Tampa Bay Rays moved back into the top spot in the American League East with a 4-2 victory against the Arizona Diamondbacks on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caminero and Aranda each homer to lead Rays past Diamondbacks 4-2

headlines.description: — Daylen Lile hit a go-ahead single in the 10th inning, Luis García Jr. homered as part of a four-hit day and the Washington Nationals beat the Baltimore Orioles 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Daylen Lile's RBI single in 10th lifts Nationals over Orioles, 4-3

headlines.description: — Cooper Ingle had a two-run single for his first major league hit, Slade Cecconi pitched six shutout innings and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Seattle Mariners 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cooper Ingle's first major league hit drives in 2 runs, Guardians edge AL West-leading Mariners 4-3

headlines.description: — Ian Happ hit a three-run homer, newly acquired left-hander David Peterson bounced back for the win after giving up a home run on his first pitch as a Cub, and Chicago beat the Milwaukee Brewers 8-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ian Happ’s 3-run homer sparks Cubs’ 8-2 win as David Peterson steadies after 1st-pitch HR

headlines.description: — Hunter Goodman hit three homers and drove in five runs, powering the Colorado Rockies to an 8-5 victory over the Minnesota Twins on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Hunter Goodman hits 3 home runs for Rockies in 8-5 win over Twins

events.name: Miami Marlins at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Xavier Edwards had three hits and Kyle Stowers hit a pair of RBI singles to lead the Miami Marlins to a 5-1 win over the St. Louis Cardinals on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Stowers drives in 2 as the Marlins beat the Cardinals 5-1

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Mookie Betts' three-run homer capped a nine-run sixth inning that also included consecutive shots by Kyle Tucker and Dalton Rushing as the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the San Diego Padres 15-3 on Saturday night to even a series between the top two...
headlines.shortLinkText: Mookie Betts' 3-run homer caps 9-run 6th inning as Dodgers beat Padres 15-3

events.name: Atlanta Braves at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Rafael Devers homered twice and drove in four runs as the San Francisco Giants beat the Atlanta Braves 5-0 on Saturday night behind Logan Webb's magnificent pitching.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rafael Devers homers twice and drives in 4 as Giants blank Braves 5-0 behind Logan Webb

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Denzer Guzman hit a tiebreaking single with two outs in the seventh inning Saturday night that sent the Los Angeles Angels to a 5-2 victory over the Athletics.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guzman, Peraza and O'Hoppe deliver late in Angels' 5-2 win over Athletics
